name: Ciarán Doyle
blurb: Student, three summers behind a bar in Salthill. Keen, a bit slow on the stout.

name: Seánie Byrne
blurb: Collects the empties, washes them and wipes the spills. Never stops talking about hurling.

name: Mags Quinn
blurb: Forty years on the floor of a Dublin bar. Nothing sits empty on a table for long.

name: Róisín Kelly
blurb: Quick, tidy and pours a lovely pint. Wants a pub that's going places.

name: Brendan Moran
blurb: Thirty years at the taps. Customers come in just to watch him pour.
